test.title: Moving jobs away from the capital

document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: In many countries, a single city attracts a disproportionate share of jobs, investment and talent, while other regions struggle to keep their young people. I agree that governments should encourage companies and public offices to relocate to smaller cities, although this must be done gradually and selectively to be effective.

The strongest argument for relocation is that it spreads prosperity more evenly. When a ministry or a large company moves to a regional city, it brings not only its own jobs but also demand for housing, shops, schools and services, which creates further employment. Kazakhstan offers a well-known example: after the capital moved from Almaty to Astana in 1997, a modest regional town grew into a major city within two decades.

Relocation would also relieve pressure on the largest cities. Overcrowded capitals suffer from expensive housing, heavy traffic and polluted air, partly because so many employers are concentrated in the same districts. Moving some of them elsewhere would make life more affordable both for those who leave and for those who remain.

Admittedly, there are risks. Companies choose large cities for good reasons, including access to skilled workers, airports and business partners, and forcing them to move could make them less competitive. For this reason, governments should rely on incentives, such as lower taxes and investment in regional infrastructure, rather than on compulsion, and should begin with public institutions that do not need to be close to their clients.

In conclusion, I believe that moving jobs away from overcrowded capitals would benefit both the regions and the capitals themselves. However, the process should be voluntary for private businesses and supported by serious investment in the cities that receive them.

note.en: Contrasts the capital and the regions in one sentence.
note.kk: Бір сөйлемде астана мен өңірлерді қарама-қарсы қояды.
note.ru: Противопоставляет столицу и регионы в одном предложении.

note.en: A concession inside the thesis: the condition for success.
The topic sentence of the main argument.
The pair not only … but also shows a double effect.
note.kk: not only … but also жұбы қос әсерді көрсетеді.
note.ru: Пара not only … but also показывает двойной эффект.

note.kk: Астаналардың шамадан тыс жүктелуінің бір себебін түсіндіреді.
note.ru: Объясняет одну из причин перегрузки столиц.

note.en: A conclusion from the concession: how to reduce the risk.
note.kk: Мойындаудан шығатын қорытынды: тәуекелді қалай азайтуға болады.
note.ru: Вывод из уступки: как снизить риск.

strengths.en: The 1997 move of the capital is a verifiable fact, not a vague claim.
strengths.kk: Астананың 1997 жылы көшірілуі — жалпы сөз емес, тексерілетін дерек.
strengths.ru: Перенос столицы в 1997 году — проверяемый факт, а не общая фраза.
strengths.example: after the capital moved from Almaty to Astana in 1997

strengths.en: The writer shows that both the regions and the capital gain.
strengths.kk: Автор өңірлер де, астананың өзі де ұтатынын көрсетеді.
strengths.ru: Автор показывает, что выигрывают и регионы, и сама столица.
strengths.example: more affordable both for those who leave and for those who remain

strengths.en: The risks are admitted and a way around them is offered at once.
strengths.kk: Тәуекелдер мойындалып, оларды айналып өтудің жолы бірден ұсынылған.
strengths.ru: Риски признаны, и сразу предложено, как их обойти.
strengths.example: governments should rely on incentives, such as lower taxes and investment in regional infrastructure

strengths.en: A relocated office creates demand for housing and services — the idea is developed.
strengths.kk: Мекеменің көшуі тұрғын үй мен қызметке сұранысты ерте жүреді — ой дамытылған.
strengths.ru: Переезд ведомства тянет за собой спрос на жильё и услуги — мысль развита.

note.en: Introduction: the problem of one dominant city and an “agree” position with a condition — gradually and selectively.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бір қалаға шоғырлану мәселесі және шарты бар «келісемін» ұстанымы — біртіндеп әрі таңдап.
note.ru: Введение: проблема перекоса в одну столицу и позиция «согласен» с условием — постепенно и выборочно.

note.en: The main argument — prosperity spreads more evenly; the example of the capital moving to Astana.
note.kk: Басты дәлел — байлық біркелкі бөлінеді; астананың Астанаға көшірілу мысалы.
note.ru: Главный довод — богатство распределяется равномернее; пример переноса столицы в Астану.

note.en: The second argument — the benefit for the capital itself: housing, traffic, air.
note.kk: Екінші дәлел — астананың өзіне пайдасы: тұрғын үй, кептеліс, ауа.
note.ru: Второй довод — выгода для самой столицы: жильё, пробки, воздух.

note.en: Concession and reply: the risks to business are admitted, hence incentives rather than compulsion.
note.kk: Мойындау және жауап: бизнеске тәуекел мойындалған, сондықтан мәжбүрлеудің орнына ынталандыру.
note.ru: Уступка и ответ: риски для бизнеса признаны, поэтому стимулы вместо принуждения.

note.en: Conclusion: the position and the condition from the introduction in new words.
note.kk: Қорытынды: кіріспедегі ұстаным мен шарт басқа сөздермен.
note.ru: Вывод: позиция и условие из введения другими словами.

document.title: Moving jobs away from the capital
document.question:
In many countries, most major companies and government offices are concentrated in the capital city. Some people believe that governments should encourage them to move to smaller towns and cities in other regions.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
